name: What are the benefits of installing under-cabinet lighting in my kitchen?
description: Under-cabinet lighting improves task visibility, reduces eye strain, and enhances kitchen ambiance and aesthetics.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of installing under-cabinet lighting in my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under-cabinet lighting improves visibility for tasks like cooking and meal prep, reduces eye strain, and enhances the overall ambiance of your kitchen. It can also highlight backsplashes and countertops, adding a modern aesthetic. Hometelligent Inc. often recommends it as a cost-effective upgrade that significantly impacts kitchen functionality and appearance, especially in older homes in areas like Alameda and Berkeley.
